templates.text: A sudden clatter → a slow blink, a faint twitch of the fingers, then stillness.
A sharp voice nearby → a delayed, shallow gasp, the head turns {seconds} seconds later.
A sustained hum → the eyes drift closed, the mouth opens slightly, but no cry emerges.
A door closing → a weak startle, the arms lift halfway then fall limp.
A rhythmic tapping → a sluggish rooting motion, abandoned after one incomplete turn.
A high-pitched ring → the brows furrow briefly, the body arches in a slow, partial stretch.
A muffled conversation → the eyes open to slits, a soft sigh, then a return to sleep.
A sudden hiss → a delayed grimace, a single weak limb movement, then relaxation.
A low rumble → a slow, incomplete Moro, the arms falling back before full extension.
A brief siren in the distance → a quiet whimper, a hand clenches, then releases after a long pause.
A metallic clang → the breath hitches, the legs draw up slowly, the response fades.
A whispered 'shhh' → the crying diminishes to irregular, hiccup-like breaths, not fully ceasing.
A burst of laughter → a confused blink, a weak attempt to turn toward sound, movement stalls.
A repetitive beep → a faint stirring, the mouth works silently, no coordinated cry follows.
A crinkling paper sound → a slow head turn begins but stops midway, gaze unfocused.
A faucet dripping → the eyes flutter open, a faint sucking motion, then lapse into quiet alertness.
A sudden cough → a minor jerk, a delayed whimper that trails off into silence.
A musical chime → a brief stilling, a slow arm lift that falters and drops.
A dog barking → a full-body twitch, a weak cry initiated but cut short after one breath.
A vacuum cleaner drone → the limbs stiffen slightly, then go flaccid over {seconds} seconds, habituating.
A book dropping → a delayed startle, the arms rise weakly and cross incompletely over the chest.
A soft lullaby → the crying rhythm breaks into irregular sobs, failing to synchronize to the melody.
A chair scraping → a slow eye opening, a faint frown, no further orienting response.
A phone vibration → a subtle tremble in the hands, a quiet grunt, then subsidence.
A sudden 'ah!' → the body tenses minimally, a weak attempt to cry results in a breathy exhale.
A steady rain patter → the infant stills, shows a brief alert face, then gaze drifts away vacantly.
A plastic bag rustle → a slow head turn toward the sound, followed by a lapse back into drowsiness.
A blender whirr → a grimace forms slowly, the hands clench into loose fists, then relax.
A key jingling → a partial orienting response, the head lifts slightly then sinks back, effort spent.
A television commercial jingle → a brief widening of the eyes, a muted coo that dissolves into silence.
